description: Breaking blocks: dirt by hand (finished, then the floor behind started and given up); stone with a wooden pickaxe, its face changed half way, then two floor blocks in turn; a torch broken at once, twice, and once while digging the floor; the block under the player (it falls, and digs on in the air); haste II, mining fatigue, digging while jumping; a stone pickaxe with efficiency III; iron ore with a wooden pickaxe; a waterlogged pane (water left behind); redstone ore lit by the first hit; creative breaking every sixth tick, a waterlogged pane there, and a sword that breaks nothing; adventure mode with a pickaxe that may break only stone.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

build: item replace entity @a hotbar.1 with minecraft:wooden_pickaxe
item replace entity @a hotbar.3 with minecraft:diamond_sword
harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
